subject: Request: top-up credits + short extension for Eastside community health pilot
messages:
From: Dr. Amina Hassan <a.hassan@eastsideclinic.org>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv.mehta@openlab.org>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for credit top-up and short extension for Eastside pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for running the pilot environment for our community health triage project. We ran into an unexpected delay: the IRB committee requested minor clarifications which pushed participant recruitment back two weeks. As a result we are likely to exceed the trial credit allocation before we collect the first full-week batch of data.

Would Redwood be able to provide a one-time top-up of 30,000 trial credits and extend the trial window by 45 days? Eastside is a registered 501(c)(3) clinic serving low-income neighborhoods; this pilot feeds directly into our Medicaid outreach work. We can share the IRB decision once finalized and the updated SOW.

If there are any eligibility forms you need filled out, please let me know. We hope to keep momentum — Rajiv from OpenLab is supporting data annotation and can confirm the schedule.

Thanks,

Amina Hassan
Medical Director, Eastside Community Clinic
a.hassan@eastsideclinic.org
(415) 555-1427

--
P.S. We may need to share a brief public-facing one-liner about the pilot if you plan to list program participants on a partner page.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Amina Hassan <a.hassan@eastsideclinic.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for credit top-up and short extension for Eastside pilot

Hi Amina —

Really appreciate the context and congrats on getting the IRB through (almost). We're happy to help keep the pilot on track. Two quick asks so we can move this to approval:

- Please attach the IRB letter (or the committee note) and the updated SOW that reflects the recruitment shift.
- Confirm Eastside's non-profit status (EIN or 501(c)(3) confirmation) — we have a streamlined path for community partners.

I'll loop in Ben and Marissa to confirm the amount and timeline. If you prefer, I can provision a provisional allocation while we wait for docs, then finalize once we receive them.

Provisional ETA for review: 48 business hours after we have the SOW + IRB.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Programs Manager, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: link to EDU eligibility form (shared in thread on approval)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Amina Hassan <a.hassan@eastsideclinic.org>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for credit top-up and short extension for Eastside pilot

Hi Amina — thanks for flagging this.

We can provision an initial top-up of 30,000 educational credits and a 45-day extension to the trial window for qualifying nonprofit pilots. This is pending the IRB letter and the updated SOW listing the revised timeline. I've attached the credit allocation terms for transparency.

Operational notes:
- Credits will be added to your pilot project and are valid for 120 days from issuance.
- We can issue a single-use credit code or add credits directly to your HubSpot deal record — whichever you prefer.

Next steps: please send IRB + SOW; once we have both Marissa will finalize the credit issuance and I will circulate the code and expiration.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

--
Attachments: credit_allocation_terms.pdf

From: Dr. Amina Hassan <a.hassan@eastsideclinic.org>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv.mehta@openlab.org>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for credit top-up and short extension for Eastside pilot

Thanks Naomi and Ben — attached are the IRB decision (minor clarifications fulfilled) and the updated SOW with new milestones.

Attachments:
- IRB-Eastside-Approval.pdf
- Eastside-SOW-Oct2026.pdf

We are a registered 501(c)(3); EIN: 94-1234567. Rajiv is on copy for the annotation schedule. If you need our W9 or grant paperwork, I can get that to you by tomorrow.

Best,
Amina

Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request for credit top-up and short extension for Eastside pilot

Hi Amina —

Thanks for sending the IRB and SOW. Confirmed — Eastside meets our nonprofit pilot criteria. We've approved a one-time allocation of 30,000 educational credits and extended the trial window by 45 days from the original end date. Details below: 

- Credit code: REDWOOD-EDU-30K-10-2026
- Issued to: Eastside Community Clinic (HubSpot deal 63412)
- Valid until: 2027-02-22 (credits must be consumed by this date)
- Terms: see attached credit_allocation_terms.pdf and DocuSign envelope for the SOW we've just routed for signature.

I'll ping legal/ops for the final DocuSign envelope; once the SOW is signed we'll close the loop on the paperwork. The credits will be visible in your trial project within 24 hours of signature, or immediately if you prefer the single-use code above.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you'd like to walk through usage patterns to stretch credits (batching, KV cache tips, etc.).

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: DocuSign-Eastside-SOW-Envelope.pdf

Subject: Re: Request for credit top-up and short extension for Eastside pilot

Marissa / team — this is great, thank you. I've e-signed the SOW and uploaded the executed copy to the Drive link you shared. The team will coordinate with Rajiv next week to migrate the annotation pipeline and we should be back on schedule.

Would appreciate the single-use code for immediate testing while the signed SOW propagates in your system.

Thanks again for moving quickly — this will make a material difference for our recruitment cohort.

Amina
